findings.text: blocking: Retirement recreates a pending journal whenever a surviving promoted pointer has none, including immediately after finish_pending_landings cleared a successfully completed journal; the reviewed importer log shows test_the_pass_merges_the_cited_head_not_a_later_one failing because that finished record reappears, so settled landings can remain or repeat instead of ending.

blocking: The station invokes this retirement before ordinary sweep work, unlinking a grouped member before retire_integrated_group_members calls _release_integrated_group_member; that existing helper returns early for an absent pointer at :138-142, skipping _release_integrated_pointer and _release_waiters_of_the_landed_section, so group pruning can discard the release work and its receipts while retaining the worktree and waiting dependants.
